title: PennantPark Investment Corporation Announces Monthly Distribution of $0.08 per Share
summary: MIAMI, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PennantPark Investment Corporation (the "Company") (NYSE: PNNT) declares its monthly distribution for November 2026 of $0.08 per share, comprised of a $0.04 per share base dividend and $0.04 per share supplemental dividend, payable on December 1, 2026 to The post PennantPark Investment Corporation Announces Monthly Distribution of $0.08 per Share appeared first on PennantPark .
